displayIdentity.body: Visions, paradise, a thorn, and strength in weakness. It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord. Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
